items.title: Anthropic faces a pricing reality check
items.oneliner: Anthropic has IPO buzz and hiring pressure, but cheaper rivals are winning users. Premium model pricing is getting stress-tested.

items.title: Qwen3.8-27B fits on a 3080
items.oneliner: Qwen3.8-27B can run on 16GB VRAM with heavy quantization. Local inference keeps getting cheaper, with obvious quality tradeoffs.

items.title: A local AI companion plays Skyrim
items.oneliner: A low-latency local companion for Skyrim shows agentic gameplay is moving from demos to usable real-time interaction.

items.title: Android car head units got malware
items.oneliner: Researchers found Android head unit malware spreading through firmware updaters. Cars are inheriting the mobile malware playbook.

items.title: AI hallucinations reached court filings
items.oneliner: State Farm's lawyers admitted AI-generated fake citations in court. Human review is still failing at the highest-stakes layer.

items.title: seL4 completed AArch64 security proofs
items.oneliner: seL4 now has complete AArch64 security proofs for confidentiality. Formal verification just became more relevant to real deployments.

items.title: AI reliability incidents are getting closer
items.oneliner: Engineers are warning that AI-run ops will trigger stranger outages soon. Reliability work is about to get much weirder.

items.title: Certificate transparency got a better search tool
items.oneliner: certgrep.sh turns certificate transparency into a practical threat-hunting tool. Security teams get regex search over internet-scale issuance.

items.title: Parquet dashboards now work from object storage
items.oneliner: A 40MB Parquet cube plus HTTP range requests can power drilldown dashboards. Analytics stacks keep collapsing into static files.

items.title: Blackstone is staffing AI inside portfolio companies
items.oneliner: Blackstone is placing 160 AI engineers across portfolio companies. Private equity is operationalizing AI, not just funding it.
